question: Within a 110 kilometers range, where can I find a restaurant on the way to Harford Artists Gallery, Bel Air, MD from Rollins Avenue Park, Capitol Heights, MD?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.902678 38.878173)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.349663 39.537824)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.902678 38.878173)',4326)::geography, 110000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.902678 38.878173)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
